ade.7f7d10c20acd260b: [[terms.matterDimension|plural]] is an Idle Incremental game created by Finnish developer Hevipelle. Originating as a solo project in 2016, it was expanded upon by a large team of developers and testers from then on. In 2024, American developer Supersonic Seven beat the vanilla game and decided to mod it for additional content and improved lore. The first public release of [[terms.matterDimension|plural]]: Endgame was issued by Supersonic Seven in 2025, and since then has been updating the game whenever possible.

ade.a4b2df25d4556445: For while my old friends have forgotten their first dream, true ambition remains steadfast.

ade.2921ca3b65a4fb10: I told him, I''m too far into this game to babysit ten thousand Destroyers.

ade.44f9206d7ab00c90: But perhaps, one day, I will meet Pelle and Lai''tela again.
ade.5c77978308c34148: And Ra, given he finishes remembering that which was taken from him.
ade.633a5737fbff8aa9: And V, arrogant wench though she is.
ade.72e41f9bd4fdf9d7: And Effarig, so long as he obtains the necessary power to survive the journey.

ade.41bd0d41c6cc2978: And... crud I forgot their names too.
ade.e4e4b2d9f114fcd1: But for now, I should await any potential arrivals.
ade.c1463186852d80e5: I am particularly gifted at predetermination, but they have surprised me before.

ade.df83e6d33577daaa: You don''t need to introduce yourself.

ade.20c692bca8c14d06: Concealing in your midst a useless power.
ade.8e2c8a3425c7fb94: It did not save you then, it will not save you now.
ade.e3da85806264ec67: Soon you will give up, and fade like the rest.

ade.1dfae91e07005686: You keep trying, knowing you will fail.
ade.7fc996fd7f7e29a9: You know you will never succeed in defeating me.
ade.2ec6a5da7c45630e: The resolve is terrifying, yet pointless.
ade.edfd44a98575220d: You must be mad, in thinking that you can win.
ade.0eb354ad3769cb97: You should never have come here to face me.
ade.6fcb1962de8ef64c: You are nothing but a fool.
ade.52c4ad74e8b5b664: All you are doing here is building your own prison.
ade.d1a767c5c6e6041d: Other times you seek, but they will grant you no repose.

ade.d4e0214951bf6ba9: Are you able to communicate with the outside world?
ade.b55c7961c629d052: Perhaps using some strange form of telepathy?
ade.2e7de50cba337e35: If you can, might I suggest something.

ade.8bfaa4c1444a3662: I don''t understand what you could be thinking.
ade.f66e518274b495f1: Look at me, even I''m trying to help!

ade.1ffc3ab62dde1ce8: Perhaps go enjoy the last moments of your life instead of fighting for an impossible goal!
ade.26491d7d8254ebae: But I cannot turn the resolve in you, can I?
ade.c6f371ced6ae0f6f: You are both exceedingly brave and exceedingly stupid for continuing on.
ade.70f1c5dae46db26a: You never learned how to give up, had you?
ade.ed0ecd27fc9c755f: Perhaps you should learn now before it destroys you.
ade.cf8b4f1d722c610e: The pain has come, and you see it.
ade.010256bd227f3add: You should''ve given up long ago.
ade.df128b73d1708f3e: The road grows ever narrower, and soon you will fall.
ade.53a2b2651b29219a: You think you see the end before you, but it is deception.
ade.a76d63138a2fca16: There is no escape for you.
ade.29b627622b303407: And with all my powers returned to me...

ade.d635c77b0e832cf4: I can finally enact my revenge.

ade.0e5892078a695bbb: Breathe the sweet air of freedom in your last few minutes.

analysis.ad.coverage: AD analyzes individual dimension multipliers. Overall combines producing tiers; select AD1–AD8 for a single tier. Antimatter/sec is shown under Antimatter Production.
analysis.sources.explanation: Sources follow the original categories. Expand a category to inspect its individual formula steps.
analysis.am.coverage: Antimatter production attribution remains approximate. Base AD1 Production and one Tickspeed rate are expandable as in the original analysis. Production powers and caps use checkpoints from the actual gameplay getter; loss is measured at the cap itself, not estimated from the product of eight dimension multipliers.
analysis.expansion.note: Rows with active child sources can be expanded. The information button shows a step’s formula and impact.
analysis.expansion.performance: Some entries may cause lag if expanded out fully. Resizing happens over 200 ms (instead of instantly) in order to reduce possible adverse effects due to photosensitivity. This may cause some visual weirdness after prestige events.
analysis.detail.traceMismatch: Mismatch: inspect game state / cached multiplier
analysis.detail.zeroProduction: Not expressible as an OoM ratio (zero production)
analysis.note.selected: This view selects {kind} sources. Direct measures them at their current inputs; Final removes each selected source from the full formula. Products include only this view's operations. The left bar shows Direct gain and loss; Final impacts are not additive shares of the final value.
analysis.note.galaxies: Each source removes only its effective galaxy count, keeping other sources and upgrades fixed. Small sources remain listed when their impact rounds to zero. Impacts are not additive; Galactic Ascension can multiply galaxy sources.
analysis.note.categories: Original source categories combine producing tiers; expand a category for its sources. Direct measures each operation at its current inputs; Final removes the category from the full formula. The left bar separates surviving gain from nerfs. Final impacts are not additive shares of the final value.
analysis.note.tiers: Grouped by dimension, as in the original breakdown: expand AD1–AD8 (or the corresponding ID/TD tiers) here without opening a different tab. The overall value describes combined multipliers, not AM/sec.
analysis.note.formula: The left bar and Direct percentages separate surviving OoM gain from losses to nerfs. Final includes later formula steps and compares each impact with the largest effect; these are not additive shares of the final value.
analysis.limits.noBinding: No binding gameplay cap or compression was detected in currently producing tiers.
analysis.limits.title: Gameplay production / overflow limits
analysis.limits.explanation: {endpoint}. The vertical bar separates retained output from losses in OoM. Each reduction is measured immediately before and after the game's own cap operation. These losses are NOT independently additive resource production gains.

analysis.am.voidNote: Void mode credits transformed Antimatter per tick; displayed AM/sec is the normal production getter, not the actual credited Void gain.
analysis.am.explanation: The AD1 amount and multiplier feed the production formula. Slabdrill core bypasses Tickspeed and production modifiers; otherwise one Tickspeed rate and the C Hadron equalizer apply before production powers and caps apply. Game speed converts game seconds into real seconds. Higher AD tiers increase AD1 amount over future ticks; their multiplier product is not instantaneous AM production. Cap losses compare the values immediately before and after each gameplay operation.
